record: Where every piece of narrative that was on the application page went (SRD-v2 FR-42 and §7; spec 014 FR-002, spec 016 FR-007). kinds.stays: The reader drives it, or reads a live figure from it. It stays, in the pane that owns it, and the destination is one of the panes of the workspace. Beat 018 turned several of these from sentences into readouts: the matter is the same and the form is not, and the note on each says so.
kinds.site: It states no live figure at all. It goes to a section of a page under docs/site/, and the test holds that section against these words.
kinds.help: It explains a panel that stays. It goes to that panel's help entry, and the test renders that entry and holds the words against it. Beat 016 built these.
kinds.dropped: It said something the surface now says better, or says for itself. It is not carried anywhere, and the reason is recorded here rather than left to be inferred from its absence.

The clause named what the two figures beside it already are: the entry reads *surface measurement, dark for warm, over 18.1 to 24.3 degrees C*, and both ends are computed figures with their kind on them. A phrase that restates the figures next to it is the second source for one fact that FR-055 forbids, in four words.

entries.matter: so it did not inform it
entries.reason: Beat 018. The consequence of the clause before it -- *dashed: measured after the forecast was initialised* -- and a legend entry that argues from its own label is explaining rather than labelling. The mark itself still says it in full: clicking one opens the selection pane, which reads *taken after this forecast was initialised, so it did not inform it*, at the mark the reader asked about.

entries.wasAt: Each horizon panel, above that panel's own skill figures
entries.matter: The scorer's own verdict on this horizon, in the scorer's words: better than persistence by 0.0 per cent; worse than climatology by 208.8 per cent.
entries.note: Beat 018, FR-008 and US4. It did not leave the surface and it stopped being the first thing on it: it is the first line inside *Where this figure came from*, one disclosure away, byte for byte as the scorer produced it and never truncated or reworded. It had been a two-line sentence drawn over the very figures that say the same thing, which made a reader read prose to find two numbers already beneath it -- the readout-written-as-prose the author's review named. Principle VI is unmoved: a losing score is visible as a figure in every state of the panel, because the skill against each reference is printed as it computes and a negative one is printed negative.
